biggest_catch: Referral amount depends on the friend's path: $50 checking+direct deposit, $50 auto/RV loan ($20k+), $100-$250 HELOC. Friend must join and open the qualifying product within 10 days and stay 60 days.
catches: Up to $350 each (referrer and referred) per friend; no limit on the number of referrals you can make.
Checking + Direct Deposit Bonus: $50 for $2,000+ eligible direct deposits across 2+ days within 60 days of account opening.
Auto Loan Bonus: $50 for a new auto/RV loan with $20,000+ balance at opening.
Home Equity Loan Bonus: $100 ($50k-$99,999) or $250 ($100k+) loan balance at opening; HELOC must take a qualifying advance within 60 days.
Referred member must join within the field of membership, open the qualifying product within 10 days of joining, and remain a member in good standing for 60 days.
One bonus per account per new member; bonuses reported to the IRS as interest.
Promotion started October 1, 2025; subject to change or termination without notice.
